tools.name: save_widget
tools.description: Save a widget (HTML, CSS and JavaScript) to Fugte and get a link for the user. Use it when the user wants the widget on a site built with a no-code builder such as Canva, Wix, Squarespace, Shopify, Notion, Google Sites, Carrd or WordPress, or wants to keep changing it later. The link opens the widge

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: save_widget · Public sink: save_widget.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: save_widget · Public sink: save_widget

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
